PowerShell($base = 'http://127.0.0.1:8765'; foreach \($path in '/api/health','/state.js','/toast.js','/modal.js','/router.js','/app.js?v=15','/styles.css?v=14'\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri \($base + $path\) -Method Head -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; "$path $\($r.StatusCode\) $\($r.Headers['Content-Length']\)" } catch { "$path FAIL $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
